data.title: 妮芙 · 图书馆还书日
data.description: 她把借来的书按大小叠好，抱到归还台前。看到旁边的新书展示，妮芙忍不住又停下来读封面。
data.camera: 中景，书架和归还台可见
data.promptProse: Staggering cheerfully toward a library return counter, Nymph balances a tall, wobbly stack of colorful illustrated storybooks against her chin. Soaring mahogany shelves, brass label holders, and broad sunlight beams piercing through stained glass cast playful prismatic patterns across the quiet, book-lined hall.
data.animaCaption: Stepping toward the library return counter, she hugs a tall, wobbly stack of colorful storybooks tucked beneath her chin with cheerful energy. Prismatic sunbeams from stained glass sweep across the towering mahogany shelves.
